title: The Man From The Fog Advancment PATCH
description: This Data Pack adds a way to obtain the impossible to get "The Experiment" advancement in TMFTF *
body:
This Data Pack  adds a way to obtain the impossible to get "The Experiment" advancement in TMFTF*

It is imposible to get the "The Experimeent" advancement in thee 1.3.1 or above version of TMFTF* beacusee the 1.3.1 version of the mod has a "minecraft:impossible" trigger to activate it so this DataPack adds a trigger that if you enter the "HALUCINATION" dimension you will get the advancement. This is meant for peaople who want to get the advancement without using cheats.

### ## **SPOILER!!!**
How to get the advancement:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


To get the advancement you need to perform the ritual on by placing the tear of the man to thee ritualblock that is in  a structure somewhere in the world it is a black archy structure with the block in the middlee by placing the Tear of the man on the block you will be transporteed to the TMFTF* dimension and will be granted thee advancement. To exit the dimension die or find the a structure with the bed in the middle just like the ritual structure after right clicking you will be transported back

</details>

Tested with 1.19.2 version may work on others  1.3.1 or newer veersions of TMFTF*

*TMFTF stands for The Man From The Fog
